title: Aš esu studentas, o tu?
description: Meet people, introduce yourself, and exchange basic personal details.

title: Gero apetito!
description: Choose food, talk about tastes, order a meal and pay.

title: Susitinkame senamiestyje!
description: Find places, follow directions, travel across town and arrange a meeting.

title: Kelintame aukšte gyveni?
description: Describe a home, ask about a rental and explain a household problem.

title: Einame į koncertą!
description: Talk about hobbies, buy tickets, recount a trip and make future plans.

title: Ar tu studijuoji, ar dirbi?
description: Describe work and studies, understand schedules and arrange dates.

title: Ar tavo šeima didelė?
description: Introduce relatives, talk about ages, describe people and compare them.

title: Ar jums nešalta?
description: Understand the weather, choose clothes and ask for a different size.

title: Kaip jautiesi?
description: Describe symptoms, make an appointment and explain an absence.

title: Linksmų švenčių!
description: Give wishes, invite guests, choose gifts and talk about celebrations.
